_comment: Documentation-sync policy for skywatcher-pr (thehub-pr ADR 0010). Read by tools/check_docs_sync.py. couplings: when a covered path changes, the doc must change in the same diff, or the commit/PR says 'Docs-Impact: none - <reason>'. Seeded conservatively: each coupling was replayed over this repo's recent history and never fired. Add couplings for docs that enumerate things; do not add ones that fire on routine work.

couplings.why: 'Federation export contract' names the two export schemas inside a code block that the reference check does not read.
'Craft profiles & querying' and 'Federation export contract' tell contributors to run these scripts, inside code blocks that the reference check does not read.
'Develop' states which Python versions CI tests and which dependency set it installs.
'Repository files' lists the parity manifest, baseline, detector, tests and gate.
